{{Quote|Terentateks? Those things that eat Force blood? Sure. In fact, I know a half breed Massassi who could take you to one.|Quarren cantina patron in Dreshdae|<ref name="shadows" />}}
A '''half-breed''' [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] lived on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] around [[3993 BBY]] and knew where to find a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Duron Qel-Droma]] and [[Shaela Nuur]], who were on Korriban on a [[Cleansing of Korriban|mission]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], looking for a terentatek were informed about this half-breed Massassi by a [[Unidentified Ithorian cantina patron|Ithorian]] and [[Unidentified Quarren cantina patron|Quarren]] in the local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of [[Dreshdae]].<ref name="shadows" />
